items.title: The cryptography behind electronic voting (and why paper ballots are still essential)
items.blurb: Cryptographic techniques can help protect ballot secrecy and prevent manipulation in electronic voting systems, but paper ballots are still essential.

items.title: Docker Urges Isolation and Governance for AI Agent Security
items.blurb: Docker has published a guide to five security risks that arise when AI agents are allowed to browse, run code and call tools with limited human oversight.
